mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_tokens (user_id, token_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, created_at, used_at FROM refresh_tokens WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND expires_at > #{now} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_tokens SET used_at = #{usedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND used_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM refresh_tokens WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (expires_at <= #{now} OR used_at <= #{usedBefore})
mapper.select: DELETE FROM refresh_tokens WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} RETURNING user_id
